levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: «وأبي» is the narrator's own father, bare: a relation with no name in this text
«ح» separates the two branches; «عن أبي وائل، عن حذيفة» is written once after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail
«قال كان رسول الله» is Hudhayfa's account: the saying's last link is Hudhayfa
